title: Robert H Possible NDE 22035
content: I remember being transported to this new world it seemed like. I remember seeing a brightly colored dome, spires, and living a whole life somewhere else. I remember being clothed in simple garb. The feeling of love was enveloping all around me. There was no fear or sorrow whatsoever. I saw colors that seem to mix together in glimmering iridescence. It was pure joy and happiness. It felt more real than anything I've experienced on earth. I did not want to leave and I was thrown back into my body it seemed. I was so upset because I was ready to go.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain Accident Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes Form seemed human but not of any concern. It didn't matter. It was of no use. It just was. Hard to describe.
elements.The experience included: Light | A landscape or city | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm It is hard to describe. My senses were all encompassing.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Complete love. Surrounded by it. All knowing of it.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe All knowing, but it was so simple.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: ome to you? No God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes It was the most beautiful experience I ever had. Not afraid of the transition.
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes It was the most beautiful experience I ever had. Not afraid of the transition. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes The magnitude of love. The colors. The feeling.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I'm starting to see 11:11 and ones a lot. Lots of ones.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The worst was coming back. The best was the whole experience there.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I tell everyone I know. Some believe, some don't, and some think I hallucinated.
